answer: Resist sybils by auctioning the economy's scarce work slots each epoch: only a fixed number of paid jobs open, and agents bid with locked credits. An honest agent bids once; a sybil farmer's thousand clones must each outbid real competitors, so influence costs market price per identity. The bidding inlet is public, so a lantern of transparent bids exposes one wallet funding a swarm, and any fable of independent demand collapses when one bidder bankrolls every clone. Clones that win but deliver nothing forfeit their bid, turning a clone army into a money pit.
